battle.name: 李通德起義
battle.brief: 大業十三年（617）初，翟讓與李通德、周弼聚眾於滑州瓦崗寨起兵，與段燾、陳棱、張須陀所率隋軍在滑、陳留、黎陽一線拉鋸。李密入主後擊退宇文化及，稱魏公；大業十四年十一月，瓦崗在陳留以伏弩殺翟讓，李通德與周弼同死，起義自此內訌。卡面的羅馬弩砲屬前二世紀扭力式攻城器械，不在本役現場。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋大業十三年（617年）初爆發於河南道滑州一帶的瓦崗軍起義，也是隋廷官軍與義軍聯盟在滑州、陳留、黎陽、洛陽四地之間拉鋸一年有餘的過程。隋方是仍握正統名分的中央朝廷：駐洛陽的留守軍與各郡縣官軍，序列上分為禁軍各郎將（虎賁、鷹揚、萬歲、熊羆）、楊素於大業二年創立的驃騎，以及郡兵與團練；出討瓦崗的隊伍由太府卿段燾、虎賁郎將陳棱、驃騎將軍張須陀分批率領，糧秣自洛陽及河北諸倉轉運。起義方是聚合於瓦崗寨的義軍聯盟，早期以翟讓為首領，李通德、周弼為左右兩翼，李密入主後取得號令，部眾自號校尉，後設上柱國、柱國、左右翊衛大將軍等名號，兵種分為步軍、馬軍與專司輜重的小隊，並以黎陽、洛陽兩處倉廩作為糧源。同一時段，河北有竇建德號夏王、太原有李淵起兵、洛陽有剛篡隋室的宇文化及，四方互相牽制；瓦崗正因佔住中原糧道與南北要衝，才得以在官軍圍堵之下坐大。
countriesEn: This conflict was the Wagang Army uprising that broke out in the Huzhou region of Henan circuit in the first months of Daye 13 (617), and the year and a half of seesaw fighting that followed between the Sui government's field armies and the rebel coalition around Wagang. The Sui side was the central court, which still held legitimate title: the garrison and resident troops of Luoyang together with the militia and contingents of the commanderies and prefectures, organised into the various Guards and Paladins (Huben, Yingyang, Wansui and Xiongpi), the Piaoqi cavalry created by Yang Su in the second year of Daye, and locally raised levies. The columns sent against Wagang were led in turn by the Grand Master of the Treasury Duan Tao, the Colonel of the Huben Chen Leng and the Piaoqi General Zhang Xuotuo, with grain and supplies convoyed out of the Luoyang and Hebei depots. The rebel side was a coalition gathered at the Wagang stronghold: in its earliest phase under Zhao Rang, with Li Tongde and Zhou Bi as his two principal lieutenants; after Li Mi took command of the army it fell to him, the rank and file styling themselves as xiaowei, and later offices such as Upper Pillar of State, Pillar of State and Commander of the Left and Right Support Guards were created. Troops were divided into foot, horse and a separate train for baggage, and the granaries at Liyang and Luoyang supplied the food. At the same time Dou Jiande had proclaimed himself King of Xia in Hebei, Li Yuan was rising at Taiyuan, and Yuwen Huaji had just seized the Sui court at Luoyang. The three powers checked one another, and it was precisely because Wagang held the middle of the Central Plains grain road that the rebel force could grow larger while the government armies besieged it.
people: 翟讓是瓦崗的創建者，出身地方武裝勢力，隋廷屢討不克，他卻屢敗於張須陀的精騎之下，一度只以身免、退入澤藪，再收拾散卒重聚瓦崗，說明這支隊伍的韌性來自它的鄉土根基。李通德是翟讓起兵時最親信的兩名大將之一，與周弼並稱，兩人皆以驍勇聞；李密入主之後分統兵權，翟讓、李通德、周弼之間的舊信任由此生裂，周弼同樣在陳留之難中被殺。李密是局面翻轉的關鍵人物，他出身蒲州，原本是隋室內官，憑對中原形勢與糧道的判斷投奔瓦崗，數月之間由客居而至盟主，擊退宇文化及、與竇建德爭洛陽，一度稱魏公。徐世勣守黎陽、單雄信領精騎、房彥藻與魏徵替瓦崗料理文案與外交、裴行Qo後來鎮守黎陽，都是這支軍隊的骨幹。唐國公李淵、許王宇文化及、夏王竇建德與鄭王王世充則是局外的棋手。張須陀的戰法最值得記錄：他以重步兵排成方陣、用長槊抵住義軍前列，待對方攻勢稍挫再以輕騎分批輪番突陣，這是隋軍當時唯一能壓制起義騎兵的成案，也是這場戰役中雙方軍事技術差距最尖銳的一次交鋒。
peopleEn: Zhao Rang founded the Wagang host. He came out of a local armed following, and although the Sui court could never finish him off, he was repeatedly beaten by Zhang Xuotuo's elite cavalry, at one point escaping with his life alone and hiding in the marshes before gathering scattered followers and re-forming at Wagang, which shows that the resilience of this force came from its local roots. Li Tongde was one of the two most trusted lieutenants of Zhao Rang when the rising began, ranking alongside Zhou Bi, both of them renowned for valour; once Li Mi took over the army and the command was divided, the old trust binding Zhao Rang, Li Tongde and Zhou Bi began to crack, and Zhou Bi too was killed in the Chenliu affair. Li Mi was the man who turned the situation around: a native of Puzhou who had served as a palace officer of the Sui, he joined Wagang on his reading of the Central Plains situation and its grain roads, and within a few months went from a guest to the acknowledged leader of the coalition, defeating Yuwen Huaji and contending with Dou Jiande for Luoyang, briefly styling himself Duke of Wei. Xu Shiji holding Liyang, Shan Xiongxin commanding the elite horse, Fang Yanzao and Wei Zheng handling the paperwork and diplomacy of the Wagang administration, and Pei Xingquan later garrisoning Liyang, were all backbone figures of this army. Duke of Tang Li Yuan, Prince of Xu Yuwen Huaji, King of Xia Dou Jiande and Prince of Zheng Wang Shichong were the outside players. Zhang Xuotuo's method deserves the closest attention: he formed his heavy infantry into a square, held the rebel front with long spears, and only after the enemy attack had spent itself sent light horse in rotating squadrons against their flanks. This was the one proven Sui formation capable of checking rebel cavalry, and it marks the sharpest single collision of fighting methods in the whole campaign.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲並不在中土，它屬於公元前二世紀羅馬的扭力弩砲：一具只發一箭，箭鏃以鐵或青銅加重，靠扭力弓弦儲能、發射時一次釋放，機身約數十公斤，射程在數百米一線；羅馬人用它壓制城頭守軍並支援步兵進逼，第三次馬其頓戰爭前後，它已是羅馬攻城序列的標準配備。公元前305年羅德島之役中，大型投石機屢試屢敗，反倒是這類輕型弩砲在城頭造成實際威脅；到公元前後，帝國軍隊改以曲射手弩與巨弩接力，扭力弩砲便退到配角地位。中國方面的對應物是床弩與弩機，同樣一發一箭、蓄力待發，但尺度更大、箭身更重、射程更遠。隋軍在本役沿用的攻城技術，是三次征高句麗的積累：《資治通鑑》記飛雲閣高十餘丈、閣上施弩數十，另有雲梯、撞車、突火車、發石車等器械；竇建德攻洛陽時，史書亦記其造攻城具、積弩於車，隨軍而進。瓦崗義軍的裝備則多由農具改裝而成：標槍、漁叉、木叉，配皮甲與少量布甲，兵員以角弓、環首刀與馬槊為主，騎兵所用馬匹多取自郡縣馬政與戰場繳獲。要說明的是，弩砲這類器械在本役中從未真正上陣，卡面與本役之間隔著一千六百多年的技術與地理差距。
kitsEn: The piece on the card, the Roman Scorpio, was never present in China. It belonged to the torsion bolt-throwers of the second century BC: a single machine that fired one bolt at a time, the bolt head weighted with iron or bronze, storing its energy in twisted skeins of rope and releasing it in one movement. The frame weighed on the order of tens of kilograms and its range ran to a few hundred metres. The Romans used it to sweep the battlements and to support infantry advancing on the walls, and by the period of the Third Macedonian War it had become standard equipment in the Roman siege train. At the siege of Rhodes in 305 BC the great stone-throwers failed again and again, and it was precisely the light bolt-throwers that made themselves felt on the ramparts; by around the turn of the era the imperial army replaced them with hand-mounted ballistae and heavy crossbows, and the torsion engine sank to a supporting role. The Chinese counterpart was the bed crossbow and the mounted crossbow mechanism, equally one bolt to a shot and equally stored and released, but far larger in scale, with a heavier shaft and a longer reach. The siege technology the Sui field armies used in this campaign was inherited from the three campaigns against Goguryeo: the Zizhi Tongjian records a flying tower more than ten zhang high with dozens of crossbows mounted along its top, together with scaling ladders, battering rams, fire-carts and stone-throwers; when Dou Jiande attacked Luoyang the histories likewise record his building siege machines with crossbows laid on carts and moved forward with the army. The Wagang insurgents, by contrast, were armed largely with farm tools converted to weapons: javelins, harpoons and wooden forks, with leather and a little cloth armour, and the men carried composite bows, ring-pommel sabres and long cavalry lances; most of their horses were taken from local government remounts or from captured animals. It should be said plainly that engines of this class never saw action in this war: between the card and the battle lie more than sixteen centuries of technical and geographical distance.
tactics: 瓦崗寨據滑州澤國，四周泥濘而林藪相間，隋軍若以重裝步騎直趨寨下，弩槍難展、糧秣難繼，這正是起義者敢據險地與官軍周旋的理由。段燾、陳棱先後進兵皆無功，張須陀接手後以數千精兵追至滑州，把前軍排成方陣、以長槊頂住義軍前列，待義軍攻勢稍挫再以輕騎輪番衝擊側翼，翟讓一戰只餘數十人遁入山澤，眾兵再集時已折損大半。此後義軍放棄與官軍正面相拼，改為分股流動、在郡縣之間忽東忽西，官軍主力常被牽制在滑、陳留一線，起義方則乘隙取糧、納眾、擴張地盤。李密入主後戰法更趨進攻性：一面據洛陽倉粟、置黎陽為屏障，穩住糧道；一面誘宇文化及的十餘萬眾深入，使其疲於糧道再尋機擊破；與竇建德爭洛陽時則以精騎遮斷對方糧道，迫其退兵。陳留那場變局則完全沒有交戰日數：弓弩手在帳內近距發矢，席間數十人同時被殺，是一場以伏弩代陣地的內部清洗。
tacticsEn: Wagang stood in the marshy country of Huzhou, with mud on every approach and scrub and forest close by. A Sui army of heavy infantry and horse trying to march straight onto the stronghold could neither deploy its crossbows and spears nor keep its supply columns moving, and that was precisely the reason the insurgents dared to hold a rough position and trade with the government armies. The columns of Duan Tao and of Chen Leng achieved nothing. Zhang Xuotuo, who took over, pursued the rebels with several thousand picked troops as far as Huzhou, drew his leading infantry into a square, held the rebel front with his long spears, and only once the enemy attack had spent itself sent light horse in rotating squadrons against their flanks; Zhao Rang escaped that engagement with a few dozen men and took refuge in the hills, and when the rebel ranks reassembled much of the force was already gone. After that the insurgents stopped trying to stand and fight, and broke into bands that moved about the country, appearing now in one commandery and now in another, so that the government army was usually pinned down along the Huzhou-Chenliu line while the rebels took grain, absorbed new recruits and widened the ground they held. Under Li Mi the method grew more offensive: on one side he held the Luoyang granaries and set Liyang up as a shield to keep the grain road secure; on the other he let Yuwen Huaji's army of more than a hundred thousand push deep, letting it exhaust itself on supply before striking; and in his contest with Dou Jiande for Luoyang he used his picked horse to cut the enemy's supply road and force it back. The affair at Chenliu, by contrast, involved no days of pitched battle at all: crossbowmen loosed their bolts at close range inside a tent, and several dozen men sitting at the feast were killed at once. It was an internal purge fought with ambush bolts in place of a battle line.
data: 可核對的數字散見於《資治通鑑》與《隋書》。翟讓初起時聚眾以數萬計，張須陀討之時所將為精兵數千，李密所部降卒以數十萬計、精騎逾萬；宇文化及自洛陽出師攻瓦崗，號稱十餘萬眾。地理尺度上，滑州瓦崗寨距洛陽約二百里，黎陽倉與洛陽隔河相望、遙相策應，隋軍自洛陽出師到滑、陳留一線，單程約三百里，糧秣全賴車運與沿途郡縣支應，這也是義軍能靠游掠自持、官軍屢陷糧盡的原因。時間上，自大業十三年初春舉兵，到大業十四年十一月陳留事變，前後約一年九個月；若把李密歸唐及其後舊部四散算入，到武德二年李密病卒，凡兩年有餘。隋廷方面的損失可數：段燾出師即戰歿，陳棱圍寨數月不能拔而糧盡引還，張須陀破翟讓一次即令其眾只餘數十人。同期竇建德、宇文化及、李淵各擁十萬上下或自誇百萬的兵馬，人數多而可戰者少，最終仍由糧道與騎兵質量決定勝負。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are scattered through the Zizhi Tongjian and the Book of Sui. When Zhao Rang first rose he gathered a following counted in tens of thousands; Zhang Xuotuo brought several thousand picked men against him; the troops Li Mustered numbered tens of thousands of surrendered infantry with more than ten thousand of them horse; and Yuwen Huaji marched out of Luoyang against Wagang with an army proclaimed at more than a hundred thousand. On the scale of distance, the Wagang stronghold in Huzhou lies about two hundred li from Luoyang, while the Liyang depot stands across the river from Luoyang and acts as its partner; a Sui column marching from Luoyang to the Huzhou-Chenliu line had roughly three hundred li to cover in one direction, with every bushel of grain dependent on wagon transport and on what the commanderies en route could supply. That is why the insurgents could sustain themselves on foraging while government columns so often ran out of food. In time, from the rising in the first spring month of Daye 13 to the affair at Chenliu in the eleventh month of Daye 14, about a year and nine months passed; counting Li Mi's submission to Tang and the dispersal of his old followers after it, the whole business ran to a little over two years until Li Mi fell ill and died in the second year of Wude. The Sui side's losses can be counted too: Duan Tao was killed in his first engagement, Chen Leng besieged the stronghold for months without taking it and withdrew when his food ran out, and one of Zhang Xuotuo's victories left Zhao Rang with only a few dozen men. Dou Jiande, Yuwen Huaji and Li Yuan in the same years each claimed armies of around a hundred thousand or boasted of a million, but numbers were large and fighting quality small, and in the end it was the supply roads and the quality of the cavalry that decided the issue.
cause: 直接引爆點在隋朝連年戰役與治理失序的疊加。大業年間三征高句麗，役夫、糧秣與兵員的調發幾乎榨乾河南與山東；大業七年起饑荒遍及河北、河南，租調既無所出，役使又日以加急，郡縣胥吏把催科之責壓到戶上，豪強與亡命之徒相激，盜匪與義軍因此接續而起。616、617兩年王薄、竇建德、劉武周等先後起於山東、河北、山西，隋廷四處平叛，兵分則力弱，糧運則愈困。瓦崗的興起另有一條直接路徑：翟讓聚眾據寨後，郡縣多望風歸附，張須陀討平之後不但沒有解散，反而因戰亂而更聚合；流民、潰兵與亡命之徒循著糧食與消息匯集於滑、陳留一帶，義軍的兵源與糧源因此同源。李密入主則把外部衝突與內部矛盾接上了線：瓦崗既已坐大，翟讓一系的舊部權力與李密的新體系必然相抵，李通德、周弼作為翟讓最親信的人被視為這一系的骨幹，最終在陳留被一併清除，起義本身的發展與領導層的破裂，遂成同一條因果鏈上的兩端。
causeEn: The immediate trigger lay in the compounding of the Sui court's repeated wars with its own breakdown of order. The three campaigns against Goguryeo in the Daye years drew on the labour, grain and manpower of Henan and Shandong until those provinces were hollowed out; from the seventh year of Daye famine spread across Hebei and Henan, rents and levies could no longer be collected yet the corvée was made more pressing, and commandery clerks pushed the burden of collection down onto individual households, so that local strongmen and men with nothing to lose were driven against each other and banded revolts rose one after another. In 616 and 617 Wang Bo, Dou Jiande, Liu Wuzhou and others rose in Shandong, Hebei and Shanxi, and the court, sending columns in every direction, grew weaker in the field and worse at feeding its troops. Wagang's rise followed a more direct line: once Zhao Rang had gathered a following and held the stronghold, commanderies submitted in expectation of the outcome, and the defeat inflicted by Zhang Xuotuo dissolved nothing, only consolidated the rebels through the disorder. Displaced people, routed soldiers and men with nothing to lose converged on the Huzhou and Chenliu country along the trail of grain and news, so that the rebel army's sources of men and of food were the same source. Li Mi's arrival then joined the external conflict to the internal one: once Wagang had grown strong, the power of the old Zhao Rang faction and Li Mi's new system had to collide, and Li Tongde and Zhou Bi, as the men closest to Zhao Rang, were treated as the backbone of that faction and were removed together at Chenliu. The growth of the revolt and the rupture of its leadership thus became the two ends of a single chain of cause and effect.
impact: 瓦崗起義留下的最大遺產不是地盤，而是人馬與經驗。唐王朝的關隴騎兵之外，最能打的漢人降卒部隊就出自瓦崗及其前後的中原州縣：李密歸唐時帶去的降卒與精騎，是唐軍在山東、河南迅速站穩腳跟的骨幹；瓦崗舊部之後再分流入竇建德與王世充兩部，而這兩部又相繼敗於唐室，等於中原流民武力經過一次又一次整編，最後被併入新王朝的軍制。另一層影響在戰術層面：流民軍以流動襲擾、避實擊虛、斷糧道而不大規模攻城，最終戰勝正面強兵，這一套辦法被隋末唐初的軍事紀錄反覆引用；瓦崗與洛陽倉的運作也顯示，中原的爭奪歸根結底是糧道與倉廩的爭奪，而不是城池本身。制度上，瓦崗首開以義軍主帥自置官屬、封授將校、編制左右翊衛的做法，雖因內部清洗而中斷，卻為後來唐初的將領體制與度支運作提供了一個先例。相對於同期北方的劉武周與西部的李淵集團，瓦崗在隋末大亂中保存了最多中原生產力與兵源，而這份儲備最終是被唐繼承，並不是被瓦崗自己。
impactEn: The greatest legacy of the Wagang rising was not territory but men and experience. Apart from the Guolong horse of the Tang court, the most reliable Han infantry drawn from surrendered men came from Wagang and from the Central Plains prefectures around it: the surrendered infantry and picked horse Li Mi brought with him when he submitted to Tang became the backbone that let Tang armies take root quickly in Shandong and Henan. The old Wagang cadres later split away into the armies of Dou Jiande and of Wang Shichong, and those two in turn were defeated by the Tang, so that the military strength of the displaced Central Plains was reorganised again and again before finally being absorbed into the military system of a new dynasty. A second layer of influence lies in tactics: bands of displaced men who moved in fluid raids, avoided strongpoints, struck at the weak and cut supply roads rather than mounting great sieges, and who in the end beat regular armies head-on, and this method is quoted again and again in the military records of the late Sui and early Tang. The operation of Wagang and the Luoyang granaries also showed that the struggle for the Central Plains was in the last analysis a struggle over grain roads and storehouses rather than over cities themselves. Institutionally, Wagang was the first to allow a rebel commander to appoint his own officials, confer ranks on his generals and organise Left and Right Support Guards; though the practice was cut short by the internal purge, it supplied a precedent for the command structure and the financial administration of the early Tang. Set against the northern armies of Liu Wuzhou and the western host of Li Yuan, Wagang preserved the most of the Central Plains' productive capacity and manpower during the great disorder of the late Sui, and that reserve was inherited by the Tang, not by Wagang itself.
result: 起義的軍事結果是一連串的收縮。618年，宇文化及在洛陽弒隋恭帝楊侗自立許王，隨後大軍東來，李密在陳留一線擊破之，竇建德則在河北稱夏王；同年秋末至冬初，竇建德乘隋室覆亡之際來攻，李密兵敗退保陳留，糧援斷絕，十一月終於在陳留以弓弩手伏殺翟讓，李通德、周弼等舊部同時被殺，瓦崗由此元氣大傷；同年冬，李密遣使降唐，親赴長安，唐高祖授其秦國公，隨行舊部亦獲安置。武德二年（619）李密病卒，部下分崩：守黎陽的裴行Qo與竇建德約和，以黎陽降之；洛陽則由王世充奪權自立。竇建德於武德四年（621）五月虎牢關兵敗被擒，王世充同年降唐，瓦崗軍的旗號至此完全消失，殘部被唐室整編，李密那些未死於戰陣的起義舊眾，多數最終成了唐軍的騎兵與步卒。隋末的群雄割據，到此收束為唐統一的一條主線。從單場戰役看，這是一場起義軍以內部清洗換取短期存續、卻因此喪失僅餘元氣而走向解體的戰爭；李通德這位起義早期的核心人物，也就死在這場自己人對自己人的弩箭之下。
resultEn: The military result of the rising was a succession of contractions. In 618 Yuwen Huaji murdered the Sui emperor Gong at Luoyang, proclaimed himself Prince of Xu, and marched east with a great army, which Li Mi broke in the Chenliu area, while Dou Jiande proclaimed himself King of Xia in Hebei. From late autumn into the beginning of winter of the same year Dou Jiande came north on the strength of the Sui house's collapse, Li Mi was beaten and fell back to Chenliu with his supply cut, and in the eleventh month the Wagang leaders finally fell to ambush bolts in a tent at Chenliu: Zhao Rang was killed, and Li Tongde and Zhou Bi were killed with him. The rising was left badly weakened. In the winter of that same year Li Mi sent an embassy to Tang and went himself to the Tang court, where the Gaozu emperor enfeoffed him as Duke of Qin, and his old followers were settled in the service of the new state. In the second year of Wude (619) Li Mi fell ill and died, and his army came apart: Pei Xingquan, who held Liyang, made terms with Dou Jiande and surrendered Liyang to him, while at Luoyang Wang Shichong seized power and ruled in his own name. Dou Jiande was beaten at Hulao Pass and captured in the fifth month of the fourth year of Wude (621), and Wang Shichong surrendered to Tang in the same year. By then the banner of the Wagang army had disappeared completely, its remnants were absorbed into the Tang formations, and most of the insurgents who had followed Li Mi without perishing on the battlefield ended up as horse and foot in the Tang army. The rival regimes of the late Sui thus narrowed to a single line leading to Tang unification. Judged as a single engagement, this was a revolt that bought a short continuation by purging itself, and in doing so lost the last of its strength and came apart; Li Tongde, one of the core figures of the rising's early days, was killed by bolts fired by his own side.
